title: Requirement
description: AI-first requirement: the WHAT derived from service-design artifacts (the WHY). JSON shape per the 2026-05 format reset (no user-story layer; provenance via traces_to; NFRs/constraints are separate doc types referenced by id, per the IEEE 830 load-bearing-separation finding). Part of the definition layer (legion #526).

traces_to.description: Provenance on the requirement itself: moment_of_truth.<id>, journey phase, or pain theme

depends_on.description: Requirement ids this depends on; cycle detection enforces consistency

nfr_refs.description: Ids of *.nfr.json documents constraining this requirement

constraint_refs.description: Ids of *.constraint.json documents binding this requirement

ui.description: UI behavior; references veneer renderings where applicable

verification.description: How this requirement is verified. The acceptance array is the AC source the verify gate (#520) reads when this requirement is bound to a card (#528); each entry is one checkable criterion. tests lists pinning test names or file:line references once implementation exists.

criteria.description: Each acceptance criterion with a stable id and its evidence kind. scenario: proven by one tagged Gherkin scenario; event: proven by something that really happens, named with who records it, never simulated; research: unknown until a toy runs, held until it does. artifact: a change to a file's text (README, CHANGELOG, a spec document), checked mechanically at the PR head.

research.description: The RESEARCH document id that holds this criterion.

artifact.description: For an artifact criterion: the file, and the text it must contain or must no longer contain; verify checks it at the PR head.

scenarios.description: One Gherkin scenario per scenario-kind criterion, at the observable level, tagged @criterion-<id>. The .feature files are generated from these and never hand-edited.
